nom: BLUME Meltdown Gel Cream for Acne-Prone Skin

avis.texte: If they made this product fragrance free I would give it five stars. Its lightweight, dries down nice, gives my skin a glowy finish, but it has a very strong sweet odor, almost like cotton candy. The fragrance really irritates my face - after putting it on, my face turns red and my eyes sting for like 30 minutes. It doesnt seem to aggrivate my breakouts but if you are sensitive to smells, pass on this one.

Blume skincare cream is a newer addition to my skincare routine, and I'm already loving it. From the first few uses, I was impressed by how lightweight and hydrating it feels on my skin. It absorbs nicely without feeling greasy and leaves my skin feeling soft and refreshed. Even though I haven't been using it for very long, it has quickly become a product I look forward to applying every day. I actually get excited to use it as part of my routine because it feels so soothing and makes my skin look and feel healthier. So far, it has been a great addition to my skincare lineup, and I can't wait to continue using it.

avis.titre: My skin has never been so well moisturized!!
avis.texte: I loooove this moisturizer! Firstly, the smell is phenomenal. Secondly, it feels so luxurious. I use it with the meltdown oil so I only need half a pump but it leaves my skin feeling so soft. I am so happy to have found a moisturizer that moisturizes well without being too heavy for my oily skin and also doesn't clog my pores.

Absolutely love this lotion so light weight but has the moisture i need even in the harsh candian winter. And the smell is to die for. I only wish there was an option to get a refill rather then buying the whole package each time

This gel cream smells heavenly! My skin loved this product. My face would just drink it up and would be so moisturized. Which was great for where I live. I got so many compliments about my skins glow and I attribute it to this gel cream.

While I enjoyed the way my skin felt after using this product, the light & natural smell and no obvious negative effects, I was very disappointed when I opened up the container to see how misleading the container size is. I have included photos that show how much product you're really buying vs the size of the container.

avis.titre: Sweet cotton candy scent, long-lasting hydration, and leaves
avis.texte: I absolutely love the scent of this moisturizer—it smells just like cotton candy and makes applying it such a fun part of my routine. Beyond the fragrance, it does a great job of keeping my skin hydrated throughout the entire day without feeling heavy. I usually use two pumps during my nighttime routine for extra moisture overnight, and I wake up with my skin feeling soft, nourished, and refreshed. It also helps keep my skin looking healthy and glowing during the day.

avis.titre: Hydrating and Smells like a DREAM!
avis.texte: This moisturizer is the perfect consistency- thick but not too thick. It leaves my skin feeling extremely hydrated. My skin is very sensitive and some moisturizers can cause irritation but this is very gentle. My skin texture and hormonal acne has also greatly improved after consistent use. The scent is very sweet- like cotton candy or marshmallow in the best way possible. Downsides- it does leave the skin a tad greasy looking but absorbs quickly. It would also be great to have an spf built into the formula.

I've been loving this moisturizer! It smells amazing to me, yet the ingredients are clean for my acne prone and sensitive skin. It's been non irritating and feels very moisturizing. The only thing I wish were different is the size of the product. While I feel like a little goes a long way, I do like to lather moisturizer on, so I'd like the volume a bit bigger. The packing itself though is very good. I've been pairing it with the meltdown oil and that has been a great combination. Would recommend!

I have used this product as my main moisturizer for just over a year now, and I can honestly say my skin has never looked more hydrated. I love that it helps keep my skin clear while making my skin so glowy!

I tried this during a trial period and that cooling sensation on first application completely won me over. It felt so refreshing and soothing going on, and my skin was noticeably softer and smoother after use. It's the perfect finishing step to lock everything in. Light, effective, and just feels luxurious. This trial made me a loyal customer and I'm obsessed.

avis.titre: Lightweight moisturizer that hydrates without clogging pores
avis.texte: I've been using this gel cream for a few weeks now, and it's quickly become my go-to daily moisturizer. The texture is super lightweight and absorbs almost instantly, so it never feels heavy or greasy on the skin. What I love most is how well it balances hydration with acne care. It keeps my skin moisturized throughout the day without clogging my pores or causing new breakouts. Ingredients like ceramides and squalane help support the skin barrier, while niacinamide and centella asiatica work to calm redness and even out my skin tone . It layers really nicely under sunscreen and makeup, and my skin feels soft, smooth, and calm after using it. It's especially great if you have combination or acne-prone skin and want hydration without heaviness. The only thing to note is that if you have very dry skin, you might need something a bit richer at night. Also, it has a slight scent, which may not be ideal for extremely sensitive skin. Overall, this is a great everyday moisturizer that delivers hydration while still being gentle on breakout-prone skin.
This is such a great everyday cream. This product has left my skin feeling so soft and hydrated without making it feel too oily.
This product smells like heaven on earth. I can't get enough of it. It also leaves my skin moisturized for the whole day!

avis.titre: The best moisturiser on the market
avis.texte: By far the best moisturiser I have ever used. I will buy again and again and again. My skin had gotten to a point before Blume where I was scared to use any product, apart from cleanser because other brands had just made things so much worse. This moisturiser smells incredible and feels even better on. It leaves me feeling moisturised but not oily - it's hydration last all day and looks great under makeup. I couldn't recommend more.

avis.titre: Loved the feel, but clogged pores BADLY
avis.texte: Really loved the feel and cotton candy smell of this gel, but it heavily clogged my skin, leaving my cheeks covered in closed comedones. It's been weeks since I stopped use (after only about 1 week of use) and sadly I'm still struggling to clear out the clogged pores it caused.

I bought this and the Melt Down Face Oil at the same time. I have sensitive skin so I tried the oil first and I absolutely loved it!! But my skin freaked out with the moisturizer. Broke out in a bumbs/rash all over my face
leaves my face feeling so soft and hydrated! the fragrance is not overpowering and even though the moisturizer is blue, it will not leave a blue tint. 10/10 recommend

I received the Meltdown Gel Cream for testing in exchange for my honest review, and after two weeks of consistent use, I am officially a convert. Dealing with hormonal acne is always a struggle—my skin usually feels inflamed, red, and stripped from spot treatments—but this gel cream has been a total game-changer!

avis.titre: My go to for AM & PM!
avis.texte: This is my go to moisturizer for both day and night! It's lightweight and leaves my oily skin balanced and my dry skin hydrated.

I am not gonna lie. I hardly ever review products AND I'm extremely skeptical. I am 54. I take care of my skin. I use prescription tretinoin, sunscreen and moisturizers. I still get hormonal breakouts and blocked pores. This gorgeous blue tansy tinted cream feels like butter and my skin loves it. Makeup glides on over it and when I apply at night my skin is moist and clear in the morning

avis.titre: perfect moisturizer for my older skin
avis.texte: This cream in combination with the cleanser is perfect for my older combination but acne prone skin. doesn't make my skin feel oily too
Really love the meltdown gel cream. Keeps me moisturized throughout the dry midwest winters and never greasy!
I love this cream, I use before makeup and alone too , is so fresh I love it
This is the best cream ever, very rich but do not cause any congestion to my skin.

avis.titre: Smells like sugar, very thick cream
avis.texte: Strong smell, but it is pleasant. Feels nice and thick, but it doesn't seem to actually absorb to help my skin keep from getting dry.
It smells like cotton candy and leaves my skin feeling clean, plump, moisturized, and amazing
I've struggled to find a clean moisturizer that moisturizes my skin but isn't too heavy under makeup. This has worked amazing with my dry, acne prone skin.

i VERY rarely leave reviews but i am extremely impressed by this moisturizer. my skin is acne prone and i have found very few moisturizers that dont make my skin look and feel absolutely disgusting. ive tried all the "acne safe" moisturizers and nothing comes close to this. it comes out thick but it emulsifies into a nice lightweight moisturizer that actually moisturizes and hydrates your skin. blume just might be my new obsession!

I had been looking for a heavier moisturizer for acne prone skin, as most of them tend to be super light and just dont cut it for the winter season. This one has been working amazing for me, I haven't had any breakouts since switching to this moisturizer. This moisturizes my skin more than other acne moisturizers, while also staying light on the skin and comfortable. There is also a slight almost fruit type scent (probably from one of the ingredients) but it goes away within seconds. I will continue to repurchase this to stay in my routine.

I am SUPER picky and also SUPER sensitive. I have tried SO many different moisturizers over the years and this one has to be one of my all time favorites. It's gentle on my skin, while offering a good amount of moisture. It seems to seep into my skin, not just sit on top of it. My skin feels SO soft and I actually love the smell of it too. I also notice a difference with my redness. I have acne prone skin and while I'm not sure if this is helping with my acne, it's not making it worse. Also love that it's affordable, cruelty free and woman owned.

Not sure what I would do without this moisturizer! It's the only thing that provides enough moisture without aggravating my acne. Everything else isn't moisturizing enough or causes me to break out. Works really well under make up too!

Love this moisturizer! It leaves my skin feeling soft and plump without and sort of greasiness. I have very sensitive skin and this is super gentle so my skin loves it. The smell is very sweet which took me a second to get used to but it does smell very yummy!

The best products I have used for hormonal acne till date. Have been suffering from hormonal acne for the last 10 years that messed up my skin and each month it would become worse with new ones cropping up. Started using Blume since October and have to tell that my breakouts have reduced significantly and ones that I get do not leave marks and heal much faster. Will report back after couple more months.

I love the packaging across all the products. With the meltdown gel cream it did dry a bit tacky. I appreciate all the healthy ingredients and the smell is actually very nice as well. It was a bit thick and coated my skin even when I minimized how much I used but I realize that it how gel creams feel. So I'd definitely recommend it if you have really dry, non-oily, skin. My skin is used to a dermatologist brand moisturizer, but I used this to test it out for about 2 months to let my skin adjust. I only had a few small breakouts in the beginning. I adjusted how much I used and then only had a few pimples every other week.

This moisturizer is truly incredible on its own, but especially paired with the other Meltdown products (face wash and oil). It's soothing, healing, and deeply hydrating. I'm not put off by the fragrance and love that it's natural, but I'd prefer if it was fragrance-free. Beyond that, this product is dreamy and worth the buy!

I dont know what is in this that made my skin go off but I experienced breakouts of all kinds (comedones, cystic, and whiteheads). Im really bummed cause they market it for acne-prone but this landed in top 5 worst breakouts from a product for me. I gave 2 stars because it does provide all day hydration without making me greasy.

It works if used correctly according to the manufacturer's instructions. Products typically take 30 days to effectively work on your skin so be patient. If you're using it properly, you'll see your acne clear up. skin may purge, and we may see more acne develop before it clears up because your skin is pushing out the bacteria and all the gunk that's deep in your epidermis. It worked for me! Buy it!

This is now my new holy grail product in my skincare. I have acne prone skin and get hormonal acne like under the skin cysts and pimples around my chin. This product does not break me out and after a month I've noticed that I have less acne, clearer skin, and less hyperpigmentation. This is the only new product in my skincare routine. I love how soft the cream is and my skin absorbs it really well. I will now be trying out other products from Blume!

This is my love letter to Blume. I just got my first Meltdown cream, and I'm at a loss for words. Everything about this product is perfect. The scent is exactly what I've been searching for all this time, and I wish all my skin- and haircare products smelled like this, even my perfume. I hope you never stop selling it, and I wish the entire Blume staff all the best and all the love you deserve. Thank you for creating the dreamiest face cream ever.

I absolutely love this cream, I've been using for years and has really helped my acne. I would usually give it 5 stars, however the new packaging is terrible. The lid is hard to take off, and the pump is also difficult and awkward to use. Please go back to the previous packaging!!

Really bummed. This is absolutely my favorite face cream I've been using it for years, however based on the listing I thought i would receive the new jar. I didn't. The cream is obviously still great I just REALLY wanted the new packaging.

It was too harsh and had no benefits for my skin. It turned my face red and bumps appeared. I did pay half price but it was still annoying to throw that amount away. I wanted to love it because it is a cute bottle.
Works better than anything I have tried for acne, including spot treatments and pimple patches. And it smells amazing. I am obsessed.

avis.titre: Not bad, but didn't work for my acne
avis.texte: Overall good product, cute packaging and smells good. Left my skin feeling soft and moisturized, but unfortunately just did not help with my hormonal acne after 60+ days of consistent use.

I have acne prone skin, it was hard to find a moisturizer that didnt break me out. I have been using this for years and i will never turn back! I have the occatiinal break out during my period but for the most part i stay clear and hydrated. I dont even wear face make up anymore, just this and spf and im good to go!

The Meltdown gel cream is my favourite moisturizer! Not only does the formula keep my face feeling silky and fresh, but it also smells like cotton candy. I've gone through three bottles already and plan to keep replenishing!
Love this product takes make up off seamlessly amazing and great for all skin types
I really like this cream! It's hydrating and leaves my skin really glowing and feeling soft. It also has a nice light scent that I enjoy!
I love the light-weight texture! It's perfect for Summer when it's more humid.
I bought a set of Blume minis from Indigo a few years ago and I can't believe how much this helped my combo skin with acne control. In just a few days, my spots were almost gone!
Really beautiful cream that is lightweight and works well in the summer.

This is a great moisturizer that feels very light and smells amazing! I use it along with a couple drops of the meltdown oil every morning and my break outs how significantly reduced over the past month!
Great moisturizer and smells like cotton Candy! I highly recommend!!
Love Blume and love a lightweight gel moisturizer for my oily skin!

avis.titre: This moisturizer leaves my skin feeling super hydrated
avis.texte: This moisturizer leaves my skin feeling super refreshed and moisturized!
I've heard from friends that it's cleared their acne, so I am so excited to try!

I love the texture of this product and how it works with all the other products. It feels smooth on my face and keeps my skin moisturized for a while! The one thing I will say is it definitely needs some reapplication later in the day. Otherwise, this product is great!

Everything was going good for the first few days, purchased this on Friday and by Tuesday morning my chin has broken out .. skin is inflamed and red with small white head/ bumps. So i must stop before it gets worst. Ot smells good and absorbs well but if you start seeing acne pop up stop using it
I want to start by saying my skin is soooo sensitive! I actually have to use a very specific acne line for my skin care, and this does not make my skin break out.

I am so pleasantly surprised! I wasn't sure if I was going to like this because I can be picky with my creams BUT LET ME TELL YOU! My skin has been loving this gel! It looks so healthy and feels so so smooth!

avis.titre: BEST GEL CREAM MOISTURIZER FOR ACNE PRONE SKIN!
avis.texte: This moisturizer is the perfect formula for those with acne prone skin as it provides long lasting hydration while having clean ingredients that won't flare up any acne. Even though it is a gel moisturizer it still is a creamy formula and gives a glass skin effect!!!

I've tried countless skincare creams, but this one truly stands out! From the very first application, I noticed how hydrating and soothing it felt on my skin. It has a lightweight texture that absorbs quickly without feeling greasy, making it perfect for both morning and nighttime use. I've also seen a noticeable difference in my complexion. I'm also a sucker for nice packaging and love how it looks on my makeup table

I have super sensitive skin and was a little worried when I noticed the cotton candy sent but it didnt cause any issues. I have dry skin and an oily T-zone and I've been using it for about a week and already see noticeable differences! I have tried many other brands and dont think I will ever switch from this one. Great product at a great price point!

I have super sensitive skin and was a little worried when I noticed the cotton candy sent but it didnt cause any issues. I have dry skin and an oily T-zone and I've been using it for about a week and already see noticeable differences! I have tried many other brands and dont think I will ever switch from this one. Great product at a great price point!

It made my face turn very red and rash out that my oblivious boyfriend even noticed it :,( it looked like I had a burn to my face. I do have super sensitive skin. I can't use many popular skin products except Kate Somerville.

I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE this moisturizer. I have acne/clog prone oily-combo skin. Since I began using retinol last year my previous moisturizer (Dew Point) wasn't hydrating my skin enough. I struggled hard to find a moisturizer that wouldn't break me out and didn't contain a multitude of oils that would make my face super oily. This is AMAZING. It's moisturizing and hydrating without being a heavy balm - gel-cream is really on the nose here. It smells exactly like cotton candy Dippin' Dots without irritating my skin which is an extra plus (according to the brand this is the scent of the preservatives they use). This blue tint is super fun as well. This moisturizer is not only very soothing and calming to my skin, but the included ceramides have made my skin SO soft. Normally I avoid putting moisturizer on top of active breakouts for fear of making them worse, but with this moisturizer doing so actually helps them shrink faster which is nuts! The ingredients in this product are AMAZING for this price tag, especially with how long one bottle lasts! I've been using the same bottle for 6 months now and I can't believe I haven't run out yet. This is 100% my new holy grail moisturizer. I really hope Blume continues to expand their product line, I would love to buy more amazing products like this! < 3

I have sensitive combination skin with rosecea on my cheeks, unfortunately this product has caused small pimples all over my face where I normally dont get any. I've never had this much acne in my life. Disappointed. I liked the texture of the product, the smell, and the price. Unfortunately I won't be purchasing it again.

I personally love this moisturizer. I've used numerous bottles of it. It's hydrating without being occlusive and heavy. It is not greasy or oily but it's also not like those typical gel moisturizers that go on like water or like a serum and don't hydrate. The scent is a true cotton candy scent, which comes from the ingredient maltol. It's amazing and I love it!!! I just don't love that they say the product is fragrance-free because that's not true. Maltol is used as a fragrance ingredient- so basically what they're saying is the ingredient list doesn't include the word FRAGRANCE lol but yes this is a fragrances/scented product. That is fine with me but may not be okay to you. I am severely acne prone - cystic acne that is sore and painful. This product does NOT ever break me out which is rare with a moisturizer.

My skin is my problem child. Acne, rosacea, large pores, its always a battle. This is the best gel moisturizer ive ever put on my face. It balances the moisture in my t zone and significantly reduced my acne within 48 hours of use. It smells amazing too. Ive never been one to be excited about skin care but i am now
I love how quickly it absorbs into my skin. It has a lovely smell and creates a barrier without being greasy or sticky. Highly recommend!
Literally the only moisturizer that really hydrates my skin without clogging my pores. It's a godsend. I just really wish they had a larger size bc I go through it so quickly.

So wanted to love this- I've been using the meltdown oil and quite like it, and do think it's helping with my acne. This cream has broken me out like crazy though! Tons of whiteheads and cystic pimples. So disappointing 😞 I can't keep using it, will have to give it away. A shame because it feels so nice on, and the smell is divine!
I have oily, acne prone skin but this helps keep my skin moisturized without adding more oiliness! Plus it smells amazing and doesn't leave my skin feeling like I put something on

avis.titre: Hydrates and smooths but made me break out
avis.texte: I really liked the way this gel cream made my face feel hydrated and with a nice texture. It was a good addition with my primer, and my face was less shiny on days I used it in the morning. Unfortunately, it made me break out after finally getting clear thanks to my other favorite Blume products. I won't finish my bottle, and I'm bummed to not love this product as much as I'd hoped!

avis.titre: Love it! Been using over a year!
avis.texte: Love it! I get cystic acne, this works better than anything my Dermatologist has ever prescribed!

avis.titre: Want to give 5, but scent made me sick
avis.texte: I want to give it 5 but I can't get past the smell. This moisturizer has a great texture, dries down nicely, and kept my skin feeling moisturized all day. Unfortunately, I was also suffering every second from the artificially sweet cotton candy scent. It is sickening. Please make this product without a cotton candy scent. If you can get past the scent, you'll enjoy this gel-like cream.
Smells like candy, feels nice on the skin and soaks in after a few minutes. Says its for scne prone skin but I have been getting little pimples and it is the only new product in my skincare routine

avis.titre: Had to buy more so my husband would stop using mine…
avis.texte: Tried this product randomly when I had a small dry patch on my face. The amazing smell was the first thing that caught my attention, but to my surprise it works really well. Looks cute, too. Texture is smooth. My skin is sensitive and often dry and I had to buy multiple bottles so I didn't have to share anymore.

I'm on my second bottle of this and I use it underneath a heavier moisturizer. This is amazing for irritation and redness associate with retinoids. It instantly calms my skin and cuts down dramatically on my irritation and dynness. If I wasn't using strong retinoids this might be enough on it's own, but it pairs nice with other thicker creams but gives all the ceramides for barrier. Love it and love the very light natural cotton candy scent. No breakouts, no irritation but lightweight hydration

My new favorite everyday moisturizer! I'm a skincare junkie and am always looking for a good moisturizer and this one from Blume…instant favorite. My combo skin has been on the oilier side lately and this moisturizer has been keeping it in check! It smells so good, quickly absorbs into the skin and keeps my skin hydrated. It also does really good at controlling my oiliness and I am just so in love with it. Highly recommend!

I've only used it twice so will update this review once I've tested it properly, but my first impressions are that it works pretty well as a moisturizer. My skin is combination- it gets both very dry and very oily at the same time. My face hasn't felt dry like it has with other moisturizers I've tried recently so I have high hopes! My main reason for the review though was that I LOVE the smell. I've been looking for a perfume that smells like this moisturizer. I know fragrance is also a negative for most in face products- not sure what kind of fragrance they've used in this product (natural or not idk). But it smells like cotton candy and please Blume make a perfume out of the smell. It smells like a Jeffree Star face powder I bought maybe 4 years ago. Just like a simple cotton candy smell without the feeling that it will give you a headache.
It is very light weight and does not feel heavy but still keeps skin moisturized.

avis.titre: 2 weeks in & I'm loving this cream so far!
avis.texte: So far I'm loving this moisturizer! I use it twice a day with the Meltdown Acne Oil & so far my experience is good. No breakouts & I look forward to seeing some other results after longer use (I'm about 2 weeks in). I love the smell if the cream alone but mixed with the Meltdown Oil, it's heaven!

avis.titre: The best affordable moisturizer for oily/combo, sensitive sk
avis.texte: Fast absorbing, non-greasy, effective and affordable! Doesn't break me out or my clog pores. I love it!
It feels really great on my skin. It's a great light weight cream that doesn't make me breakout. And it smells so yummy! :)
It works for me to clear and prevent acne I have paired it with the Milky Fade Serum to even out my skin tone.

avis.titre: Great product, smells great, could use different container
avis.texte: Great product. Smells amazing. Just wish the packaging was in a jar so you're able to get every last bit of it out of the container. I hate wasting any amount of a high quality product I'm spending good money on.
This smells amazing and makes my skin feel milky soft, it's my new favorite moisturizer! I just wish I could see when I'm getting near the end of the bottle.

I was using the whirl moisturizer for a long time, and was sad when it was discontinued. I reached out to customer service and they recommended this moisturizer in place of whirl. i have to say, i think this is definitely an upgrade. I have acne prone combination skin and this keeps me glowing and acne free. I recommend this product to everyone!

I LOVE this cream so much! I have combination skin so it's hard to find products that work for me! It's hydrating but doesn't clog up my pores. It's perfect for when I'm feeling a break out coming on! 💖

I have acne prone skin that for the most part is quite dry but I struggle often with blackheads in my T-zone area. So it can be difficult for me to find a lightweight moisturizer for the summer months that won't exacerbate blackheads but also won't leave me with dry patches. This moisturizer is the perfect lightweight acne-friendly product that still does a fantastic job of keeping my dry skin moisturized and hydrated! And the SMELL is AMAZING. I have very sensitive skin and the fragrance does not irritate it at all which was a really nice surprise! And a little goes a long way with this product! One pump covers my entire face. I would highly recommend giving this moisturizer a try!
In love with this moisturizer. The texture and smell are the perfect combo
Works like a charm and feels so good on the skin, not sticky!
Love the texture and results of using this product! It also smells amazing which is a huge plus. My skin is so happy! 🤩

avis.titre: Creamy, rich, and pleasant—but perhaps better for Winter use
avis.texte: I live in arid Colorado and have been using this for about a month now. It's creamy and absorbs quickly without leaving an oily residue. The smell is pleasant and my combo skin seems to generally be happy from using it. That said, I think that this would be better for winter and Whirl better for summer (because this is thicker and richer than Whirl). I do recommend trying it out!

I wanted to love this but I feel like it's nothing special. I have sensitive skin and for me, the barometer of whether or not something is gentle is how it feels when I apply it after shaving. Like most other products, this stings quite a bit. Also, for my very oily skin, the texture feels too creamy; I was thinking it would be more gel-like. I will use the bottle I bought but will not purchase it again.
I already see a huge improvement in my skin after just two weeks! I pair it with the milky fade and spot treat with the acne oil. My skin is actually clearing up!
